inviteLinks.title: The $t(common:product) app
inviteLinks.intro: Invites can open the $t(common:product) app on people’s phones, where they set their password and start, or the web when they don’t have the app.
inviteLinks.description: Off by default. Invite links and “Send me a link for the app” go through $t(common:product)’s link page, which shows this workspace’s address before it opens anything. Only where the app can reach this workspace (https, on its usual port); elsewhere invites stay as they are.
inviteLinks.saved: Invites that open the app turned on
inviteLinks.saved_off: Invites that open the app turned off

policy.title: The $t(common:product) app on phones
policy.intro: A phone keeps a copy of this workspace for the $t(common:product) app. These rules reach each phone the next time it signs in.
policy.periods: A phone that hasn’t reached the workspace for the first period locks its copy until the person signs in again, and erases it after the second, unsent work included.
policy.invalidDays: Use a whole number of days from {{min}} to {{max}}.

appLock.title: Require the app lock
appLock.description: Off by default. When on, the app asks for Face ID or a fingerprint to open this workspace.

notificationText.title: Show message text in notifications
notificationText.description: On by default. When off, notifications on phones say only that something new came, not what.
notificationText.saved: Message text in notifications turned on
notificationText.saved_off: Message text in notifications turned off

policy.versions: The app follows the lock and erase periods now; it follows the app lock and the notification text from the version that supports them.

logs.title: Mini app logs
logs.intro: Each build and start of a mini app keeps its log. An attempt is kept for the days below or while it is one of the app’s last attempts, whichever keeps more; older ones are removed in the background, and the one running now never is. Only the app’s owner and admins can read them.
logs.invalid: Use a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
